info.title: WIPS Global Mobile API
info.description:
Bearer-authenticated global JSON API. Mobile trip tracking is separate from ERP custody, dispatch and inventory receiving. See README.md for setup, retry ordering and rate limits.

Production base URL: https://wips.ph/api/v1. Imported from the WIPS project OpenAPI definition; no live login or tracking changes were performed. See [WIPS API usage guide](./wips-api-guide.md) for setup, offline event/GPS retry ordering, evidence uploads and rate limits. Authenticate with WIPS username/password and an installation UUID, then paste the returned token into Authorize.

post.description: HTTP 200 can contain rejected items. Keep those queued. The same UUID and identical payload return duplicate. Stop events need stop_id; skipped/issue events need payload.notes. trip.returned requires payload.last_gps_sequence, with 0 meaning no samples captured. Start requires all ERP shipments in_transit. No event changes stock or receiving.
